test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a class examination, the average score of 35 students was 44. Later, it was discovered that twice 25 was wrongly recorded as 33, and once 36 was wrongly recorded as 34. What is the actual average score of the class?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total error = (33 − 25) × 2 + (34 − 36) → 16 − 2 = 14

Correct total marks = Old total marks − Total error

Old total marks = Average × Students = 44 × 35 = 1540

Correct total = 1540 − 14 = 1526

Correct average = Correct total ÷ Students = 1526 ÷ 35 ≈ 43.6

**∴ Answer = 43.6**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Students = 35, Old average = 44

Errors: (33 instead of 25 twice) and (34 instead of 36 once)

**Formula used:**

Correct average = (Old total marks − Total error) ÷ Total students

 Old Total Marks = 1540 Error: (33 − 25) × 2 + (34 − 36) = 14 Correct Total Marks = 1540 − 14 = 1526 Correct Average = 1526 ÷ 35 ≈ 43.6 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Old total = Average × Students = 44 × 35 = 1540

⇒ Total error = (33 − 25) × 2 + (34 − 36) = 14

⇒ Correct total = 1540 − 14 = 1526

⇒ Correct average = 1526 ÷ 35 ≈ 43.6

**∴ The correct answer is 43.6 (Option 1).**
